dedupe_keys.name: multiconfiguration borehole distributed acoustic sensing seismic dataset acquired at the pitop test site

description: Olga Nesterova and collaborators publish active-seismic distributed-acoustic-sensing observations from the PITOP test site. Zenodo provides cross-hole and vertical-seismic-profile archives free under CC BY 4.0. A fibre cable extends 150 metres down a borehole. Cross-hole experiments use a sparker source, while vertical profiles use a nearby vibroseis source; two gauge lengths permit comparison of recorded wavefields. These measurements can benchmark seismic propagation and fibre-sensor responses used in subsurface infrastructure investigation. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this collection. Coverage is one instrumented field experiment, with acquisition date, exact gauge lengths, channel spacing and internal file encoding not established in the landing metadata. Limitations include sensor coupling and source geometry, which affect transfer to another site. No archives were downloaded, waveforms inspected or inversion and detection accuracy independently tested.
